verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a CRM API, webhooks and SDKs, but nothing about API version numbering or a deprecation policy. The only versioning mention is 'integration versioning' for custom integrations in the technical account, which is a different feature from versioned APIs and earns no credit. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404s, so there is no machine-readable spec showing versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
